content.user_title: Search and Interpret the Human Metabolome Database
content.value_statement: Metabolomics researchers need reliable guidance for navigating HMDB records, spectra, biomarkers, and bulk datasets. This skill explains search methods, key fields, evidence checks, and practical workflows for using HMDB with Claude or Codex.
actual_capabilities: Explains text, structure, spectral, and advanced search options available through HMDB.
Maps HMDB fields for chemical properties, biospecimens, pathways, diseases, proteins, spectra, and external identifiers.
Recommends XML, SDF, FASTA, text, CSV, or TSV downloads for different analysis needs.
Outlines workflows for metabolite identification, biomarker discovery, pathway analysis, and database integration.
Describes HMDB access limits, citation expectations, commercial permissions, and alternatives to web scraping.
limitations: The skill does not provide a live HMDB API client or bundled dataset.
HMDB has no public REST API, so authorized programmatic access may require contacting its team.
Database counts, versions, URLs, and licensing terms can change after the skill was published.
HMDB associations and predicted data require independent scientific validation and are not clinical advice.

use_cases.title: Identify Untargeted Metabolites
use_cases.description: Plan HMDB searches and evidence checks for candidate metabolites from mass spectrometry or NMR experiments.

use_cases.title: Review Biomarker Evidence
use_cases.description: Locate concentration, disease, biospecimen, pathway, and citation fields needed to assess a proposed biomarker.

use_cases.title: Plan Data Integration
use_cases.description: Select bulk download formats and map HMDB identifiers into a reproducible local analysis pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Metabolite Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find [metabolite name or HMDB ID] in HMDB. List the fields I should verify and explain why each matters.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Metabolite Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the HMDB evidence I should collect for [candidate A] and [candidate B], including mass, structure, biospecimen, pathway, and citation fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Spectral Identification
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an HMDB workflow for identifying [unknown feature] from [MS, MS-MS, GC-MS, or NMR] data. Include confirmation criteria and uncertainty reporting.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Local Integration Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a reproducible pipeline for integrating the HMDB [XML or CSV] download with [local database]. Include field mapping, provenance, update checks, and validation.

output_examples.input: What should I verify when looking up glucose in HMDB?
output_examples.output: Start with name and synonym searches. Verify the accession, formula, monoisotopic mass, structure identifiers, biospecimen evidence, pathways, and record citations.

output_examples.input: How should I evaluate an LC-MS candidate with an exact mass match?
output_examples.output: Treat exact mass as preliminary evidence. Compare adducts, isotope patterns, retention behavior, MS-MS fragments, specimen plausibility, reference spectra, and evidence quality.

output_examples.input: Which HMDB download format fits a local metabolite catalog?
output_examples.output: Use XML when comprehensive nested fields are required. Use CSV or TSV for simpler tables, and preserve HMDB accessions and source version metadata.

best_practices: Record the HMDB version and access date for every analysis.
Confirm metabolite identities with orthogonal evidence, including spectra, structure, mass, retention time, and biological context.
Prefer bulk downloads for large studies, then preserve source identifiers, citations, and provenance in derived datasets.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a name match or exact mass alone as a confirmed metabolite identification.
Do not automate web scraping when an approved download or authorized access method is available.
Do not use biomarker associations or predicted values as clinical conclusions without expert validation.

faq.question: Does this skill query HMDB directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for HMDB web searches, downloads, field interpretation, and research workflows.

faq.question: Can I use a public HMDB REST API?
faq.answer: The skill states that HMDB has no public REST API. Contact the HMDB team for authorized programmatic access.

faq.question: Which download format should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose XML for comprehensive records, SDF for structures, FASTA for sequences, text for spectra, or CSV and TSV for tables.

faq.question: Can HMDB confirm a metabolite from exact mass alone?
faq.answer: No. Confirm candidates with spectra, structure, retention behavior, specimen context, and other independent evidence.

faq.question: Can I use HMDB biomarker data for clinical decisions?
faq.answer: No. Review source evidence and obtain qualified clinical validation before making diagnostic or treatment decisions.

faq.question: What should I record for reproducible research?
faq.answer: Record HMDB accessions, database version, access date, query criteria, selected fields, evidence status, and citations.
